SetFunctionValue fV
End

float fM1
ref rF1

SetFunctionValue 1
End

float fM1
ref rF1
float fA
Begin Function { }
let fM1 := GetModIndex "FalloutNV.esm"
let rF1 := BuildRef fM1 1068157
let fA := player.GetAngle Z + player.GetHeadingAngle rF1
player.SetAngle Z fA
SetFunctionValue 1
End
